_comment: Row 250 / v3.66.1255. The regression restores the exact laundering defect: a failed git status is published as dirty=clean. The real probe fixture makes every earlier Git step succeed, forces status to exit 19 exactly once, and asserts dirty=unknown. Run from a detached scratch copy with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/v3_66_1255_bd_fleet_distinct_states.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. The companion v3_66_1255_bd_fleet_distinct_states_transform_control.json applies the same bytes to a test that reaches the failed-status branch without judging its dirty value; it must ESCAPE, proving this CAUGHT verdict is behavioral rather than a broken shell transform.
subject: v3.66.1255 -- bd-fleet never launders failed cleanliness measurement into clean
